role: Senior Product Marketing Manager, B2B SaaS

must_haves.question: Has the candidate held a role whose work is clearly product marketing (positioning, messaging, launches, or sales enablement)?
must_haves.true: At least one role doing product marketing work, even if titled differently.
must_haves.false: Marketing work that is only demand generation, events, or brand, or no marketing at all.

must_haves.question: Has the candidate done marketing work for a B2B software or SaaS product?
must_haves.true: At least one role marketing software sold to businesses.
must_haves.false: Only consumer, agency, or non-software marketing.

scored.question: How many years of product marketing work does the resume show?
How much hands-on experience leading product launches does the resume show?
levels: Led one or two launches end to end
Led many launches end to end, with results

scored.question: How strong is the evidence of positioning and messaging work the candidate personally created?
levels: Owned positioning across a portfolio or company

scored.question: How much sales enablement work does the resume show (training, battlecards, pitch decks)?
levels: Built or ran an enablement program

scored.question: How much evidence is there of using data to guide marketing decisions (win/loss, market research, pipeline analysis)?
